subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + temporary 180d debug-log retention for Aurora pilot
messages:
From: Leah Carter <security@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + 180d debug log retain for Aurora pilot

Marcus —

Thanks for the demo last week. As we discussed in the security review, Aurora needs two things for the upcoming pilot: (1) copies of your SIG/CAIQ mappings and a redacted SOC 2 report for our infosec review, and (2) a short-term retention variance to hold debug/session traces for one tenant for 180 days (our default retention asks go beyond your standard 30d).

Scope/details: we only need this for the pilot tenant (tenant-id will be provided). Access will be limited to our security and forensics engineers. We also expect an attestation that logs will be retained in an isolated bucket, encrypted with a customer-segregated KMS key and audited access only.

Could you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can provide a CAIQ/SIG export and a redacted SOC 2 (or SOC 2 map) for review?
- Your internal process for issuing temporary retention variances and what compensating controls you can put in place (kms separation, restricted access, proof-of-delete after the window ends).
- Any procurement/DocuSign or SLA amendments we should expect (procurement is cc'd).

I attached our standard questionnaire to this message. If you prefer a short call to align, we can schedule.

Regards,
Leah Carter
Security Program Manager — Aurora Health
[Attachment: aurora_sig_caiq_questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Carter <security@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:35:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + 180d debug log retain for Aurora pilot

Leah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the questionnaire. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide CAIQ/SIG mappings and a redacted SOC 2 summary; and we can support a scoped, temporary retention variance for a single tenant with compensating controls.

Proposed approach (summary):
- Evidence: redacted SOC 2 summary + SIG to CAIQ crosswalk + CAIQ export (redacted PII sections)
- Variance model: 180-day tenant-scoped retention with constraints:
  * Tenant-specific storage bucket (tenant-only path)
  * Customer-scoped KMS key (separate key material) and standard rotation policy
  * Role-based access: only Aurora security principals with MFA + pinned RBAC
  * Read-only SIEM export to Aurora's collector (optional) and audit log forwarding
  * Proof-of-delete workflow and signed attestation at end of variance window
- Delivery: we'll package artifacts in a single evidence bundle and share via secured Drive link and an encrypted attachment.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal runbook check with our compliance team (Irene) — I'll kick that off.
2) We prepare the evidence bundle and a one-page retention variance agreement for Procurement.
3) If procurement signs, we execute the tenant uplift and provide access to the retained logs under the controls above.

Attachments I will produce: retention_variance_proposal.pdf, retention_evidence_bundle.zip (SOC2 redacted, CAIQ export, KMS summary).

Is Aurora comfortable with the one-page variance (fast) followed by a DocuSign SLA amendment? If so, I'll loop Procurement with a draft.

Thanks —
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:02:08 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aurora retention variance — evidence & approvals needed

Irene / Neha —

Aurora (security + procurement cc'd) has asked for: redacted SOC2, CAIQ export, and a temporary 180d retention for debug/session logs on a single tenant. They want the logs isolated, encrypted with a customer-scoped KMS key, and an attestation/proof-of-delete at the end of the window.

Can you confirm the following items are available and whether we have any blockers?
- Redacted SOC 2 summary (we can remove customer-specific annexes)
- SIG to CAIQ crosswalk + CAIQ export (redacted)
- KMS model: can we allocate a per-customer key for a pilot, and do we have a documented rotation/SCB (key material separation) statement?
- Proof-of-delete workflow and attestation template (who signs internally?)
- Any billing/pricing for retention variance (Neha to advise)

I'll be replying to Aurora with a short proposal. If you prefer, we can do a 30-min sync today.

Thanks —
Marcus

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:48:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Aurora retention variance — evidence & approvals needed

Marcus —

We can assemble the bundle; below are the specifics and locations.

Available artifacts:
- Redacted SOC 2 summary (remove operational details/attachments): file name SOC2_2026_redacted_summary.pdf (stored in secure drive).
- SIG to CAIQ crosswalk + CAIQ export: CAIQ_SIG_crosswalk.xlsx (we'll strip URIs and customer emails).
- KMS key model: we can create a tenant-specific envelope key under our KMS authority. Rotation summary: keystore_rotation_summary.pdf.
- Proof-of-delete: we have a signed attestation template (proof_of_delete_template.docx) that the Compliance lead signs. For a pilot, Product Security signs and Legal countersigns if procurement needs it.

Drive links (internal) — I'll stage a sanitized evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/security/aurora-evidence (access will be restricted). I will prepare retention_evidence_bundle.zip with the items above and a short variance_agreement_onepager.pdf.

Notes:
- Technical constraints: we will not retain raw PII in the retained debug traces; any PII will be pseudonymized where feasible. Full pseudonymization mapping will not be exported.
- Audit trail: all accesses during the variance will be logged to an immutable audit feed (we can provide a sample audit export).

I'll stage the artifacts by EOD Monday. Neha, can you propose a cost uplift for 180d tenant retention (ballpark) so Marcus can include it with Procurement?

Irene
Director, Product Security — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: keystore_rotation_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Carter <security@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aurorahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:21:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + 180d debug log retain for Aurora pilot

Leah —

Per our internal review, attached is a short proposal and the evidence bundle (redacted SOC 2 summary, CAIQ export, KMS rotation summary) staged for your review: retention_variance_proposal.pdf and retention_evidence_bundle.zip.

Key points from the proposal:
- Scope: single tenant (tenant-id to be confirmed by Aurora).
- Controls: tenant-isolated store + customer-scoped KMS key + RBAC and audit-only access + signed proof-of-delete at 180 days.
- Data handling: no export of raw PII; traces will be pseudonymized and access audited.
- Operational: we need a signed one-page variance (attached). Procurement: this will be a short DocuSign amendment to the Master Services Agreement.
- Cost: Neha (cc) proposes a one-time setup fee + monthly holding fee. Neha, please confirm numbers and I'll send a consolidated procurement packet.

If this approach works, please confirm the tenant id and approve proceeding to DocuSign. Once procurement signs, our Security team will enable the tenant-scoped retention and share access details to Aurora's security principals.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: retention_variance_proposal.pdf, retention_evidence_bundle.zip]
